reply.text:
Congratulations, that's a big six weeks. When you can run again after birth is a medical call, not a coaching one, and it depends on how your delivery and recovery went. Your doctor or a pelvic floor physio can clear you, usually around your postpartum check-up, and they can tell you what's right for your body.

Once you have their go-ahead, tell me and I'll build the return around it, starting easy and building from there. In the meantime, if you want some training that's cleared for you, I can set up something with you now.
